title: Quick one — founder intro? (Copperline Metrics, Series A)
body:
Hi Dana,

Hope the offsite went well. Quick one before I make any promises to anyone.

I've been spending time with Ravi Menon, founder and CEO of Copperline Metrics — they do usage-based billing infrastructure for industrial IoT fleets. We passed at seed because it was outside our mandate, but I've stayed close and the numbers have moved fast: roughly $1.4M ARR, up 3x since October, with net revenue retention north of 130%. They're kicking off a Series A, targeting $12M, and Ravi specifically asked about Foxglove after seeing your metering-infrastructure post from March.

A few things worth knowing. His co-founder and CTO, Lena Hartwig, built the metering pipeline at a large European energy exchange before this — she's the reason the product works at scale, and honestly half the reason I'd back them. Their lead angel is Astrid Kovac, formerly CTO at Vantabright Systems, who put in at pre-seed and has been an unusually hands-on board observer. Astrid is supportive of a priced round and isn't pushing for structure, which I know matters to you.

Standard double opt-in: I haven't told Ravi anything yet beyond "let me check with a friend." If it's a fit, I'll connect you two directly. If not, no harm — I'll tell him the timing didn't work.

Worth an intro?

Best,
Sam

--
Sam Okafor
Halcyon Capital

title: Re: Quick one — founder intro? (Copperline Metrics, Series A)
body:
Sam,

Yes — please connect us. This is squarely in our wheelhouse and the timing is actually good; we just closed out our spring pipeline review and have room for one more infrastructure deal this quarter.

Two data points that make me lean in. First, I know Astrid Kovac a little — Theo Marchetti introduced us at a CasselBlu dinner last year, and she struck me as exactly the kind of angel you want on a cap table: technical, direct, no games. If she's hands-on with Copperline and still adding, that tells me something. Second, the Lena Hartwig background you describe is the profile we keep looking for and rarely find. If she really ran metering at exchange scale, the usual "will it hold up past 10k endpoints" diligence question mostly answers itself — though I'll still want her on the first call, not just Ravi.

One flag so you're not surprised: I may bring Nordwind in early. Maya has been mapping industrial IoT billing since February and I'd rather co-develop the view with her than duplicate work. I'll keep that between us until Ravi and I have spoken.

Go ahead and make the intro whenever suits — happy for you to share my direct line too.

Thanks for thinking of us, Sam. I owe you one (that's two this year, by my count).

Dana

--
Dana Whitfield
Partner, Foxglove Capital

title: Intro: Dana Whitfield (Foxglove) <> Ravi Menon (Copperline Metrics)
body:
Ravi, Dana — connecting you two, with pleasure.

Ravi: Dana Whitfield is a partner at Foxglove Capital and one of the sharpest infrastructure investors I know. She's written extensively on metering and billing infrastructure (the March piece you mentioned was hers) and leads with conviction rather than committee. When we passed at seed for mandate reasons, Foxglove was the firm I told you to remember for the A.

Dana: Ravi Menon founded Copperline Metrics in 2024 and has done more with less than almost any founder I track — the ARR trajectory speaks for itself, and the customer references I've called are unprompted-enthusiastic. As mentioned, his co-founder Lena Hartwig runs engineering and is worth meeting early; she's usually heads-down but Ravi can pull her into a first call. Their angel Astrid Kovac has offered to speak with prospective leads directly, which in my experience she actually means.

I'll step back and let you two find time. Ravi — Dana is happy for you to have her direct line; she'll share it in thread.

Good luck both. Ravi, keep me posted; Dana, lunch is on me either way.

Sam

--
Sam Okafor
Halcyon Capital

title: Re: Intro: Dana Whitfield (Foxglove) <> Ravi Menon (Copperline Metrics)
body:
Ravi,

Great to be connected — Sam doesn't make many intros, so when he does, I pay attention. (Sam, moving you to cc with thanks.)

I've read what's public on Copperline and I'm genuinely interested. Two asks before we meet:

1. Could you send over the deck and, if you're comfortable, a metrics snapshot (ARR by cohort, NRR, gross margin)? A one-pager is fine at this stage.
2. Would you bring Lena Hartwig to the first call? Sam speaks very highly of her, and given the scale questions in your category I'd rather hear the architecture story from the person who built it. If she's underwater with the current release, a follow-up technical session works too.

I'm also looping in Maya Chen, partner at Nordwind Ventures (cc'd). Maya and I have co-invested twice and she's spent the spring mapping exactly your category — her associate Jonas Berg has a landscape memo on industrial IoT billing that I suspect you'd half-agree and half-argue with, which is the fun kind of first meeting. To be clear: no syndicate is formed here, we'd each make our own call, but I'd rather be transparent that we compare notes.

On timing — how does Tuesday 19 May look, 15:00 or 16:30 London time? 45 minutes, video. If Astrid Kovac is willing to take a reference call in the following week or two, I'd gladly take her up on Sam's mention of that.

Looking forward to it.

Dana

--
Dana Whitfield
Partner, Foxglove Capital
